% =====================================================================
% Noetic Compass Press — full-wrap print cover
% Generated by build_covers.py. Do not edit directly; edit the driver.
%
% Geometry is exact KDP: 0.125in bleed on all four sides, two 6x9 panels,
% and a spine of pages x 0.002252in (white stock). The barcode clear zone
% at back-cover bottom-right is left empty per KDP's requirement.
% =====================================================================
\documentclass[12pt]{article}

\usepackage[
  paperwidth=\WRAPWIDTH,
  paperheight=\WRAPHEIGHT,
  margin=0pt
]{geometry}
\usepackage{fontspec}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usetikzlibrary{calc}

% Ligatures=TeX is required or "---" prints as three literal hyphens and
% ``quotes'' stay straight.
\defaultfontfeatures{Ligatures=TeX}
\setmainfont{Palatino Linotype}
\newfontfamily\displayfont{Palatino Linotype}[Ligatures=TeX]
\newfontfamily\monofont{DejaVu Sans Mono}

\definecolor{ink}{HTML}{\INKCOLOR}
\definecolor{accent}{HTML}{\ACCENTCOLOR}
\definecolor{paper}{HTML}{\PAPERCOLOR}

\pagestyle{empty}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}

\begin{document}
% shift to current page.south west so (0,0) is the physical bottom-left of the
% sheet. Without it, overlay coordinates are relative to the text cursor and
% almost the entire cover draws off the page.
\begin{tikzpicture}[remember picture, overlay,
                    shift={(current page.south west)},
                    x=1in, y=1in, every node/.style={inner sep=0pt}]

% --- full bleed background -------------------------------------------
\fill[paper] (0,0) rectangle (\WRAPW, \WRAPH);

% Panel origins. Bleed is 0.125in; back panel starts at the bleed edge,
% spine follows, front panel last.
% back:  x in [0.125, 6.125]
% spine: x in [6.125, 6.125+S]
% front: x in [6.125+S, 12.125+S]

% --- spine block ------------------------------------------------------
\fill[accent] (\SPINEX, 0) rectangle (\SPINEXEND, \WRAPH);

% ============================ FRONT ==================================
% Accent rule near the top of the front panel
\fill[accent] (\FRONTX+0.75, \WRAPH-1.55) rectangle (\FRONTX+5.25, \WRAPH-1.50);

% align=flush left, not align=left: with a text width the latter still lets TeX
% shrink interword space to fit the measure, which squeezed "Thinking in" into
% "Thinkingin" at display size.
\node[anchor=north west, text width=5.1in, align=flush left]
  at (\FRONTX+0.75, \WRAPH-2.05) {%
  \displayfont\bfseries\fontsize{40}{44}\selectfont\color{ink}\TITLELINEA
};

\node[anchor=north west, text width=4.5in, align=left]
  at (\FRONTX+0.75, \WRAPH-\TITLEDROP) {%
  \displayfont\itshape\fontsize{17}{22}\selectfont\color{ink!75}\SUBTITLE
};

% Geometric mark, drawn from the book's own content
\node[anchor=south west] at (\FRONTX+0.75, 2.15) {\MARK};

\node[anchor=south west]
  at (\FRONTX+0.75, 1.30) {%
  \displayfont\fontsize{21}{24}\selectfont\color{ink}\AUTHOR
};

\fill[accent] (\FRONTX+0.75, 1.12) rectangle (\FRONTX+2.15, 1.15);

\node[anchor=south west]
  at (\FRONTX+0.75, 0.62) {%
  \displayfont\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\color{ink!70}NOETIC COMPASS PRESS
};

% ============================ SPINE ==================================
% Rotated 90deg, reading top-to-bottom as on a shelf.
\node[rotate=-90, anchor=west, text=paper]
  at (\SPINEMID, \WRAPH-0.95) {%
  \displayfont\bfseries\fontsize{\SPINESIZE}{\SPINESIZE}\selectfont \SPINETITLE
};
% With rotate=-90 and anchor=east the text ENDS at the anchor and runs upward,
% so these two y values are the FEET of each line. They must clear each other's
% length or the author name and the imprint collide.
\node[rotate=-90, anchor=east, text=paper]
  at (\SPINEMID, 2.05) {%
  \displayfont\fontsize{11}{11}\selectfont \AUTHOR
};

% Imprint at the foot of the spine. Standard shelf convention, and the thing
% that makes three separate titles read as one press.
\node[rotate=-90, anchor=east, text=paper, opacity=0.82]
  at (\SPINEMID, 0.55) {%
  \displayfont\fontsize{7.5}{8}\selectfont NOETIC COMPASS PRESS
};

% ============================ BACK ===================================
\node[anchor=north west, text width=4.6in, align=left]
  at (0.75, \WRAPH-1.05) {%
  % braces around the substitution: \bfseries\HOOK would concatenate into an
  % undefined \bfseriesWe and silently eat the first word.
  \displayfont\fontsize{15}{19}\selectfont\color{ink}\bfseries{}\HOOK
};

\node[anchor=north west, text width=4.6in, align=justify]
  at (0.75, \WRAPH-\BLURBDROP) {%
  \displayfont\fontsize{10.5}{14.5}\selectfont\color{ink!88}\BLURB
};

% author bio, sits above the barcode zone
\node[anchor=south west, text width=4.6in, align=left]
  at (0.75, 1.75) {%
  \displayfont\fontsize{9.5}{13}\selectfont\color{ink!75}\BIO
};

\fill[accent] (0.75, 1.55) rectangle (1.75, 1.58);

\node[anchor=south west]
  at (0.75, 1.05) {%
  \displayfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{ink!70}\CATEGORY
};

\node[anchor=south west]
  at (0.75, 0.62) {%
  \displayfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{ink!70}NOETIC COMPASS PRESS
};

% KDP barcode clear zone: 2.0 x 1.2in, bottom-right of the back panel, inset
% 0.25in from trim. Nothing is drawn here -- the paper colour is already light
% enough for the barcode, and filling it white would print as a visible box.
% The zone is reserved by keeping all back-cover content left of x=3.6in and
% above y=1.55in.

\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
